propositions: The typecheck target (make typecheck) runs mypy over src/rebar only, leaving 47 .py files under scripts/ lint-clean but type-unchecked, despite scripts/ already being under ruff checks.

Scripts that implement CI gates (e.g. scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py) are invoked directly in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:108 but lie outside the mypy type gate, creating inconsistency between what is gated and what enforces the gate.

Widening the typecheck target to include scripts/ surfaces 15 mypy errors across 6 script files, most annotation debt but including 2 latent bugs: capture_jira_fixtures._truthy calls .strip() on str | None, and check_complexity_baseline._run_lock passes possibly-None dict where dict[str, int] is required.

The sys.path bootstraps in 9 scripts/ files do not block mypy inclusion because pyproject.toml already sets follow_imports=silent and ignore_missing_imports=true, absorbing path-injected imports without generating import errors.
Type-gate scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml stale and must be updated to reflect widened mypy coverage of src/rebar + scripts/.
A guard test (tests/unit/test_typecheck_scope.py) must verify that scripts/ remains in the typecheck recipe and detect regression if the target is later re-narrowed.
